rationale: Identity was verified correctly using full name and zip code. The agent reviewed orders via tools and identified an earbud to exchange. However, the agent executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy. Additionally, the agent did not clearly verify the order’s fulfillment status before using the delivered-item exchange flow, and it provided a specific refund amount and item specs that were not clearly substantiated by the visible tool output. Despite the user’s satisfaction, these policy violations mean the request was not completed in line with the stated requirements.
